name: Eva Victor
bio:
Eva Victor (born 11 February 1994) is a French-American actor, writer, and director. They appeared in the television series Billions from 2020 to 2023, and made their directorial debut with the self-starring independent film Sorry, Baby (2025), for which they were nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture - Drama.
